text:
Maya (AE): quick ask — seed-stage POC for Lumen Labs (YC S23). originally approved 50k tokens, but they need more for long-context docs + image refine loops. Can we increase credits and extend the trial window? also they're stuck on the SSQ.

Ravi (SalesEng): brief on workload — two experiments: doc->summary (avg ~4k tokens) and image->caption->refine with iterative steps. rough usage if fully exercised: ~300k tokens over ~2 weeks. latency not critical but throughput must be consistent for benchmarking.

Maya (AE): customer request = 250k extra tokens and +1 month on trial. no ARR yet, founders hoping for "accelerator-friendly" terms. they signed our standard trial TOU but infosec questionnaire still pending.

Lina (DealDesk): @Maya please confirm USD equivalent at list and whether they'd accept a small prepay/commit if we add credits. also need POC acceptance criteria / simple SOW.

Maya (AE): at list pricing that's tiny (rough calc: $30 per 1M tokens -> 250k ≈ $7.50) but we'll treat as credits. founders can maybe do a $5k light prepay for 3 months, but said budget is tight.

Tom (Finance): note we typically cap trial credits for startups — standard is 100k. exceptions need deal-desk + finance. if approved, we need an addendum that makes extra credits billable if they keep using after the cap/trial.

Priya (RevOps): I can authorise a one-off promo if conditions met: (1) cap total credits at 300k, (2) expiry 30 days, (3) signed pilot addendum on file. also need legal entity and billing contact for ledger SKU.

Maya (AE): legal: Lumen Labs Inc. (DE). contact: ef@lumenlabs.ai (founder). they'll sign pilot addendum.

Lina (DealDesk): my checklist: signed addendum, sec questionnaire acknowledgement (sec must confirm outstanding items), and $1k refundable deposit or CC preauth preferred. if present, DealDesk can approve +250k credits.

Ravi (SalesEng): outstanding SSQ items = network topology diagram + data retention policy clarifications. customer says they can deliver those within 48h. we should only provision after sec confirms "no PII processed" or equivalent flag and retention policy attached.

Maya (AE): I'll push for signatures and the network diagram. can RevOps provision once done?

Priya (RevOps): yes — I will create a single-use promo code linked to their external_id and expiry. please send external_id and confirm the signed addendum before I issue anything.

Tom (Finance): approval conditional on documentation. please include explicit clause in the addendum: "unused credits expire; any usage beyond credited amount billed at standard rates." finance wants that exact language recorded.

Lina (DealDesk): I'll draft the addendum and tentatively approve the 250k bump subject to: signed addendum, sec signoff on outstanding items, and $1k refundable deposit or CC preauth. if those are met I'll mark as approved and instruct RevOps to issue the promo. :white_check_mark:

Maya (AE): action items:
- Maya: secure addendum signature + network diagram (ETA 48h)
- Ravi: validate SSQ outstanding items and escalate if delayed
- Lina: draft addendum
- Priya: standby to generate promo code once addendum present

Jon (Customer-Success): fyi I'll schedule a 30-min post-POC check-in to review outcomes and discuss next steps/upsell. please loop me into the trial kickoff.

security-bot: Security questionnaire received for Lumen Labs Inc. — status: pending (network diagram + retention policy required). link: https://sec.internal/q/AL-452

Lina (DealDesk): marking request in-flight. final approval after addendum + sec clearance.

Priya (RevOps): example promo I'll issue once approved:

```
PROMO: LUMEN-250K-APR
AMOUNT: 250000 tokens
EXPIRES: 30 days from issuance
CONSTRAINTS: single-use; bound to external_id
```

Maya (AE): if sec is slow (>72h) can we do a temporary smaller bump (100k) to unblock a demo?

Lina (DealDesk): possible fallback — 100k temp credits with revocation clause if sec raises issues. prefer full addendum though.

Priya (RevOps): I'll prepare ledger entry template and wait for external_id + signed doc.

Tom (Finance): please log the conditional nature of this promo on the account record.

Maya (AE): thanks everyone — I'll update this thread EOD with progress. :rocket:
